ideas.solution_description: A web service that helps individuals locate and understand the status of their old, forgotten 401(k)s and other retirement accounts. Users provide their employment history and SSN, and the service automates the search process across major plan administrators, providing a consolidated view of their retirement assets.
ideas.core_features: Automated search across major plan administrators, dashboard to display found accounts and their current status, guided steps to contact plan administrators, educational resources on 401(k) rollovers/consolidation, secure data handling.
ideas.revenue_model: Transaction fee: 0.5% of funds successfully located and transferred/consolidated (capped at $500 per account), or a flat fee of $99 per successful account discovery.
ideas.first_user_step: User signs up, enters their Social Security Number (SSN) and a list of previous employers with approximate employment dates into a secure form.
ideas.target_user: Individuals who have worked for multiple employers and may have lost track of old retirement accounts, especially those nearing retirement or looking to consolidate finances.

ideas.core_features: Advanced ad-blocker with customizable visual/auditory complexity filters, content summarization tool for web pages and videos, 'distraction-free mode' for popular sites (e.g., YouTube, news sites), customizable background soundscapes for focus, notification muting.
ideas.revenue_model: Subscription: $4.99/month or $49/year for full features. A limited free version with basic ad-blocking and one soundscape.
